fact: The Ministry of Public Service launched online processing through its website of civil-service requests (trienio recognition, civil-servant card issue or renewal, certificate of non-separation), with UNDP support, per AhoraEG.
Equatorial Guinea's vice-presidency says its VFS Global-run e-visa service, launched 2023-07-01, has processed about 35,127 e-visas.

CNEDOGE, per its own notice carried by Farol EG Noticias, put its platform into operation for requesting official documents online, with payment note generation, resuming a request after payment and real-time status tracking.
